Name: Ready Check Kick
Author: weizinai
Description:
[font=Arial][size=6]中文介绍
Introduce[/size]

[size=3]In the vanilla multiplayer game, when there are many players online, some players often fail to ready up during the night transition phase or preparation phase. This mod displays the names of unready players on the screen, provides an automatic kick feature for inactive players, and adds a [/size][color=#ff0000]kup [/color][size=3]command that allows players to kick unready participants[/size]
